practicalCriteria: Training completed is recorded with its date, trainer and evidence location, and is not recorded as competency
Each task marked as authorised has an observed competency record with an observer and a method
Each task not yet observed or not yet adequate is listed as a restriction
Licences or authorisations are recorded only as held and checked against the document
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
evidenceRequired: signed acknowledgement from staff member and supervisor
stopWorkCriteria: Do not allow a person to carry out a task listed as not yet authorised
Do not allow a person to carry out a licensed task until the licence is checked and recorded
